research.name: hairline
research.note: Thirty-three isometric SVG line figures that react to the pointer, for React or plain DOM with no dependencies.

effects: isometric hairline SVG figures that answer the pointer
tray of cards where the card under the pointer stands up
field of pillars that rises around the pointer
conveyor belt whose clock slows on hover with a live rate caption
turntable of blocks that spins on a flick and settles
dot matrix painted by the pointer with a phosphor afterglow
